protocol.noise_definition: AWGN added to DC-centred ROI; noise DC removed per A-scan and scaled to exact ROI RMS SNR. Repeated raw hashes share the same realization. Frozen models and thresholds; no retraining.
protocol.transfer_target: All 7000 experimental rows, no target training or validation; encoded simulated sizes not mapped to millimetres.

tfm.model: homogeneous longitudinal straight ray; full aperture; linear time interpolation
tfm.interpretation: Metadata-assisted lower-tip ROI, not blind localisation. Nominal tip is approximate; weld anisotropy and time-zero uncertainty remain.

provenance.dtype: float64 FFT and noise; float32 stored maps
provenance.duplicate_policy: Identical raw images share the realization within each replicate and SNR
provenance.rng: CUDA generator seed = replicate*100000 + unique-batch start index; noise reused across SNR levels
